verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Claude Code can run on a schedule for repeating work such as morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis and weekly dependency audits. They also say its app can schedule recurring tasks, and CI integration via GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD offers another automation path. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how schedules are configured (cadence syntax, where jobs run, failure handling or notifications), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work reliably.
